datasets.name: Hyderabad metropolitan area (illustrative)
datasets.description: Illustrative urban expansion around settlements and transport corridors, with land-use transitions from agriculture and vegetation.
datasets.simulated_label: Illustrative Dataset: a generated demonstration layer, not satellite imagery.
datasets.source: Generated by the reusable pipeline app.explorer.atlas; no satellite data are used for these layers.

rules: Built-up grows outward from eight settlement nuclei and along an outer ring corridor and radial roads; once built it stays built.
Agriculture and vegetation are lost where the built-up front passes.
Water bodies are nearly stable; tanks inside the densest fabric lose their edges after 2010.

provenance.note: Two-date comparison taken from JRC's own transition layer.
